parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation; foreign documents accepted; self-determination act and equal-treatment act signal respectful institutions, with hate-crime counselling infrastructure. Frictions are visitor-relevant but not universal bans: airport screening harassment (one documented complaint, outcome unknown), sauna access decided privately amid dispute, and a prison system whose default is binary birth-sex placement with gender-identity placement only exceptional — a documented custody exposure (one 2026 case of a legally female prisoner sent to a men's prison, safety rationale) that reaches visitors only upon arrest. The state sometimes frames trans women as risks (prison safety rationale, sauna debates), and hostile political rhetoric exists, but no organised targeting, no facility bans, and remedies (equal-treatment complaint, constitutional equality, court review) exist even if effectiveness is partly unproven. Sits above the 0.55 tier (no repeated uncorrected misconduct pattern) but below 0.75 due to the unremedied custody default and unresolved screening complaint.
